Desc: The Arabica Select collection is for discerning coffee drinkers who appreciate authentic, specialty-grade Indian coffee, expertly blended from farms with heritage and recognition — delivering the genuine flavours of Coorg straight from estate to cup. DAWN is a signature blend crafted from the celebrated Baragalli Estate, recognized by its Geographical Indication (GI) status, and enriched with AAA-grade Arabica cherries exclusively from Coorg. This washed and sun-dried Arabica blend exemplifies Estate Monkeys' commitment to origin purity and top-tier quality. DAWN stands out for its enveloping chocolaty note—rich and bold, yet balanced with a subtle natural sweetness that reflects the best of Coorg’s coffee terroir. Origin: Single-origin, Coorg (Baragalli Estate + Arabica Cherry AAA) Packaged in a 250g pack, our coffee is freshly roasted and sealed to preserve its aroma and flavour. Brew it strong, enjoy it black, or pair it with frothy milk for the ultimate South Indian filter coffee experience.
